compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Client projects that supply their own criteria (`.rebar/criteria_routing.json`) must be able to run the same eval harnesses rebar uses for its core evals: plan replay, fixture mining, and provider parity. Today those harnesses hard-code repository paths under `docs/experiments/` and write into whatever checkout they run from, the `evals` extra is unregistered, and 13 MB of executable research artefacts live under `docs/`. The operator ruled on 2026-09-06 that the hard-coded paths are a bug and the harnesses must be exposed to clients.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every harness resolves its corpus, ledger, and output roots from one configured key with a client-appropriate default, and rebar's own outputs are path-identical before and after. Checked by the precedence tests and the no-hard-coded-roots assertion.
- [ ] The research corpus lives outside `docs/` in a non-shipped top-level tree, every reference points at the new location, and neither the wheel nor the sdist ships it. Checked by the repo-wide grep and the build assertions.
- [ ] A client can follow one documented section to run each harness against its own criteria, the `evals` extra is registered and documented, and the 71 orphaned fixture-drift tasks are closed with a recorded reason. Checked by the doc test and the tracker query.

## Child decomposition
- Config seam story: delivers criterion 1.
- Corpus move story: delivers criterion 2, depends on the config seam.
- Client documentation story: delivers criterion 3, depends on the corpus move.
compiled_state.title: Expose the eval harnesses to client projects: configured corpus roots, no hard-coded repository paths, research corpus out of docs
